answers.question: What is included in the Flex membership, and what does it cost?
answers.answer: The Flex membership costs $120 per month. It includes eight workspace visits per calendar month, use of shared desks (not an assigned seat), internet access, drinking water, and use of the shared kitchen. Unused visits expire at month-end and do not roll over. Meeting rooms, printing, and optional event tickets are billed separately. [S1] [S2]

citations.content:
HARBORLIGHT WORKSPACE
Membership and pricing
Harborlight Workspace is a fictional coworking space used to demonstrate Recall. This handbook
describes its example policies for November 2026. All people, prices, services, and procedures in this
document are fictional. It is a product demonstration document, not an agreement with a real business.
The Flex membership costs $120 per month and includes eight workspace visits per calendar month. A
visit is counted when a member checks in, regardless of how long they stay. Unused visits expire at the
end of the month and do not roll over. Flex members use shared desks rather than assigned seats.
The Resident membership costs $240 per month and includes unlimited workspace visits during normal
opening hours. It also includes a dedicated desk and a small lockable drawer. Resident membership
does not include overnight access. Both membership types include internet access, drinking water, and
use of the shared kitchen.
Membership charges are collected on the first day of each month. A member may switch plans for the
following month by submitting a request before the 25th. Plan changes do not take effect immediately.

answers.question: How much does the Maple meeting room cost, and how many people can it seat?
answers.answer: The Maple meeting room costs $20 per hour and seats eight people. [S1]

citations.content:
HARBORLIGHT WORKSPACE
Meeting rooms and reservations
Harborlight has two meeting rooms. Cedar seats four people and costs $12 per hour. Maple seats eight
people and costs $20 per hour. Room charges apply to both membership plans. A membership
provides workspace access but does not include complimentary meeting-room hours.
Reservations can be made up to 14 days in advance. Each reservation must last at least 30 minutes
and no more than three hours. A member may hold up to two future room reservations at a time. Once
a reservation ends, it no longer counts toward that limit.
The member who books a room must attend the meeting and remains responsible for the reservation.
Rooms may be used for team discussions, interviews, or video calls. The number of people in the room
must not exceed its stated capacity. A room reservation does not authorize access outside normal
opening hours.
Members must check in for a room within 10 minutes of the scheduled start. After that grace period,
reception may release the room to another member. A released reservation is treated as a no-show and
is charged in full. A reservation ends at its scheduled time even when the meeting begins late.

answers.question: When can I cancel a meeting-room reservation and receive a full refund?
answers.answer: You receive a full refund of the room charge if you cancel at least 24 hours before the reservation’s scheduled start time. If Harborlight cancels because the room is unavailable, the room charge is fully refunded regardless of notice. [S1]

citations.content:
HARBORLIGHT WORKSPACE
Cancellations and refunds
A meeting-room reservation canceled at least 24 hours before its start receives a full refund of the room
charge. A cancellation made less than 24 hours before the start receives no refund. The cancellation
time is measured against the scheduled start, not the time the member originally made the booking.
For example, canceling a Thursday 2:00 p.m. room reservation by Wednesday 2:00 p.m. qualifies for a
full refund. Canceling it on Thursday morning does not. Moving a reservation to another date counts as
canceling the original booking and creating a new one, so the same refund deadline applies.
If Harborlight cancels a reservation because a room is unavailable, the room charge is refunded in full
regardless of notice. Members may accept an alternative room instead, but only with their agreement.
Refunds return to the original payment method and are submitted within five business days.
To end a membership, a member must submit a cancellation request before the 25th of the current
month. Access continues through the final day of that month. Requests received on or after the 25th
take effect at the end of the following month. Monthly

answers.question: How long can a guest visit for free, and what happens if they stay longer?
answers.answer: A member may bring one guest per day for free for up to two hours, provided the host remains with them. If the guest stays longer than two hours, they need a $15 day pass (subject to available space), which allows workspace use until closing that day and excludes meeting-room charges. [S1]

citations.content:
HARBORLIGHT WORKSPACE
Guests and shared-space rules
Each member may bring one guest per day for up to two hours without a guest fee. The host must
remain with the guest throughout the visit. Guests must sign in at reception and wear a visitor badge. A
guest visit does not create a separate membership or provide independent workspace access.
A guest staying longer than two hours needs a $15 day pass, subject to available space. The day pass
covers workspace use until closing on that day. It does not include meeting-room charges. A member
hosting a meeting must account for the room's capacity even when guests have day passes.
The quiet zone is reserved for individual work. Phone calls and video meetings are not permitted there,
even when headphones are used. Members may take short calls in a phone booth or book a meeting
room for longer conversations. Phone booths cannot be reserved and have a 30-minute continuous-use
limit.
Food is permitted in the kitchen and lounge, but not in the quiet zone or meeting rooms. Drinks in
closed containers are permitted at desks. Members should clear shared desks when leaving for the day
and return borrowed chargers to reception. Personal items left

answers.question: How much does black-and-white printing cost per side?
answers.answer: Black-and-white printing costs $0.08 per printed side. [S1]

citations.content:
HARBORLIGHT WORKSPACE
Printing, storage, and support
Black-and-white printing costs $0.08 per printed side. Color printing costs $0.30 per printed side.
Double-sided printing therefore incurs two side charges for each sheet. Printing is billed separately from
membership. Members confirm the number of sides and whether color is needed before submitting a
print job.
Print files are automatically removed from the print queue after 24 hours, whether or not they were
printed. This rule applies to uploaded print files, not to membership records or payment records.
Members should collect printed pages promptly. Reception does not check printed documents for
accuracy or completeness.
Resident members may keep personal work materials in their assigned drawer during an active
membership. Shared desks do not include storage. Lost-property items are held for 30 calendar days
after they are found. Members can ask reception about a missing item by describing it and giving the
approximate date it was lost.
